question: Who among the following has been honoured with the Global Child Prodigy Award 2020 in January 2020 for achievements in spiritual discipline yoga?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Ishwar Sharma**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ishwar Sharma** has been appreciated with the **Global Child Prodigy Award 2020.**
 
• This award is related with** Yoga. **
 
• He accepted his Certificate of Achievement at a **special event in New Delhi in January 2020** attended by Nobel laureate** Kailash Satyarthi **and Lieutenant Governor **Dr. Kiran Bedi of Puducherry.**
 
• **10-year-old British Indian yoga boy** Ishwar Sharma wins international Child Prodigy Award.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/604dfc6caa8e8e0a32293336adeaf5994a6d76c16f0971f4b0a07728276d5df6.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Advait Kolarkar** was acknowledged between thousands of nominees, and the association awarded this **young prodigy for his artistic talent.​ **
 
• **Jyoti Kumari,** the 15-year-old girl had **cycled 1200 km from Gurugram to Bihar **over eight days with her ailing father in tow, has been given a trial by the **Cycling Federation of India.**
 
• **Reuben Paul **became CEO at such a young age and spreads knowledge about **Cyber Security. **
